breaking_news.headline: But first, coffee: The drink that energized the American Revolution
breaking_news.summary: Colonial Americans were drinking coffee long before they dumped tea into Boston Harbor or fought a war for independence. The establishments that served it were already brewing revolutionary ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.

breaking_news.headline: Hate food waste? 7 creative ways to turn your leftovers into a new meal
breaking_news.summary: We asked our audience to share their favorite go-to recipes for leftovers. Here are seven dishes — like stuffed peppers and a biryani casserole — that can help you use up all your fridge scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Meet 'Project 2029' — and its war on the annoyance economy
breaking_news.summary: Remember Project 2025? Democrats are building their own governing blueprint, and one proposal takes aim at the "annoyance economy": robocalls, endless hold times, hidden fees and other everyday frustrations.

breaking_news.headline: This factory was severely short on workers. Then it offered flexible work
breaking_news.summary: A GE Appliances plant in rural northwest Georgia was short hundreds of workers amid COVID-19. A flexible work option where some workers can sign up for shifts through an app has eased the pain.

breaking_news.headline: Tensions with Iran add fresh uncertainty to an already shaky global economy
breaking_news.summary: Crude oil prices jumped and stock prices fell after President Trump declared an end to the ceasefire with Iran, adding fresh uncertainty to an already shaky outlook for the global economy.

breaking_news.headline: Should you sign your kids up for Trump Accounts? Four things to consider
breaking_news.summary: Families can still benefit even if their children aren't eligible for the free $1,000 contribution from the federal government.

breaking_news.headline: New aviation mechanics graduate with jobs in hand, thanks to a labor shortage
breaking_news.summary: Aviation is literally soaring in the U.S., with record passenger numbers. But with a generation of mechanics set to leave the workforce, the industry needs new graduates to fill the gap.

breaking_news.headline: Starmer gifted gun and ammunition by Turkish president at Nato
breaking_news.summary: The weapon has not been brought back to the UK and has instead been left with British officials in Turkey.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-Olympian pleads not guilty to Reflecting Pool vandalism charges
breaking_news.summary: A former US Olympian canoeist denies accusations that he deliberately damaged the lining of the refurbished Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine strikes Russian ships near Crimea, escalating attacks on fuel supplies
breaking_news.summary: The attacks appear to be the latest phase of Ukraine's bid to choke off supplies and routes into and out of occupied Crimea.

breaking_news.headline: Greek F-16 fighter jet crash-lands at busy Zakynthos airport
breaking_news.summary: The runway is closed after the jet reportedly landed without deploying its landing gear before bursting into flames.

breaking_news.headline: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation
breaking_news.summary: The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

breaking_news.headline: Big fall in oil, gas and cargo ships taking US-backed Hormuz route after new strikes
breaking_news.summary: Data shows a decline in the number of ships - many carrying oil and gas - going through the waterway after attacks this week.

breaking_news.headline: Tehran launches more strikes after explosions reported in southern Iran
breaking_news.summary: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: Virgin Media fined after hanging up on customers trying to cancel contracts
breaking_news.summary: Millions of phone calls from customers were "likely mishandled" over nearly a three-year period, the regulator says.

breaking_news.headline: Life of Sizewell B extended by another 20 years
breaking_news.summary: The power plant was due to reach the end of its life in 2035 but will now continue until 2055.

breaking_news.headline: Wealthy AI workers send San Francisco house prices soaring
breaking_news.summary: The median cost of a home in the city is now $1.7m, a record high, according to the latest figures.

breaking_news.headline: Jackdaw boss warns of winter fuel shortage risk if gas field not approved
breaking_news.summary: Adura says the UK government must approve North Sea production urgently to avoid domestic supply shortages.

breaking_news.headline: Porn site company fined £630,000 over failed age checks
breaking_news.summary: Ofcom has fined a slew of sites it says are failing to prevent children accessing their adult content.
